classes.name: Language
classes.description: A controller class for handling language-related events within the catalog module of OpenCart. It extends the base Controller class and implements methods for managing language data during different stages of controller execution.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that dumps all language variables into the template, ensuring missing args are filled with existing language data.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Pre-controller hook that stores current language data in a backup before the controller executes.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Post-controller hook that restores language data from backup after controller execution.
